Lua 5.4.9, from https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz (as pinned in nixpkgs, SHA-256
2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6), unchanged. It runs the mods'
scripts. Only the core and the base, coroutine, table, string, math and utf8 libraries are here:
mods reach files, the network and the rest through the kit. Its licence is at the end of lua.h.
